narrative_shape: Implementation is already behind the first tail, then the session becomes a long disc-check wait and ends there. Turn 68: 152 tests pass, a stale process is killed, and the worker reviews compare_disc and context while the reference check runs. Edit 12 and Write 11 do not grow after that. Turns 84–90 re-arm a monitor on a detached self-check (level 0, 200/1836, then a second pass) and hold the commit. T=100, so the wait is the end state.
